summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern, without running any tests or repository code and without committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class holding the translated update algebra list; (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None), which wraps translateUpdate output in Update and sets _original_args, and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now accepts an Update object by unwrapping its algebra; (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; (4) test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py adds four tests covering return type, applying the update, reuse, and initNs. The tests have not been run. Design choices: processUpdate is unchanged; Update takes only algebra because prologues are stored per operation; no docs or examples were added.
